text: A people in command, if it be duly restrained, will have the same prudence and the same gratitude as a prince has, or even more, however wise he may be reckoned; and a prince on the other hand, if freed from the control of the laws, will be more ungrateful, fickle, and short-sighted than a people.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
